description: This file contains the implementation of the IdentityTokenClaimService class, which generates JWT tokens for users by retrieving user information and roles from the UserManager, and creating a token with claims including username and roles.

classes.name: IdentityTokenClaimService
classes.description: Service responsible for creating JWT tokens with user claims.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a specified user, including username and role claims.
